content:
Succeeding Tim Cook as Apple CEO in September, John Ternus is expected to make several changes upon taking the helm, but one thing that's certain is that Apple's loss-making TV streaming service won't see any overhauls…

Speaking to Reuters, Ternus said the company intends to continue pushing forward with its streaming service.

Ternus said that after taking the reins of the iPhone maker in September, he's committed to maintaining the company's strong momentum in the entertainment business… Speaking to Reuters on the red carpet at the premiere of Ted Lasso Season 4, Ternus said: "I think the momentum at Apple TV is really strong right now. There are so many great shows, so many incredible characters and stories, so we're just going to continue that momentum."

Outgoing CEO Tim Cook echoed this sentiment, saying he's excited about the success of the F1 movie and believes "there will be more like it." We learned last month that a sequel to the film is in the works, and Apple's senior VP of services Eddy Cue added that even "bigger and better" content is coming to Apple TV.

Ted Lasso Season 4 premieres next week, and the company has also teased the arrival of Severance Season 3.
